How to use Uplink ServiceOps Console

For service desk technicians and small IT teams who want tickets, assets, projects and network operations in one console. Private for now.

Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Sign in; a personal practice lab is created the first time.

2

Open the queue and take the first ticket.

3

Search a site, IP address or serial number from the global search.

4

Update the ticket status as you work.

5

Switch to the dark theme in low light.

02

Features

01

Tickets

A queue with status-coded workflows.

STEPS

  1. Take a ticket
  2. Change the status as you work
  3. Close it with a resolution
02

Assets

Devices with serial numbers, sites and owners.

STEPS

  1. Search a serial number
  2. Update the owner or the site
  3. Link the device to a ticket
03

Projects and network

Projects with tasks, and network operations organized by site and address.

STEPS

  1. Open a project and check off tasks
  2. Open a site
  3. Check its addresses
03Tips
  • Search first, then open the module.
  • Practice in the lab before working real tickets.
  • Use the dark theme in low light.
04FAQ
Can I try it?

Not yet. Email to request a walkthrough.

How does it relate to Uplink?

It is the console Uplink learners will move on to.

When does it launch?

After Uplink. No date yet.
